Posterior Data Preparation

Source: R/RcppExports.R
coint_prepare_sur_data.Rd

Generates the input matrix for the simulation of the cointegration matrix \(\beta\).

Usage

coint_prepare_sur_data(w, alpha, k, r, reparameterise, tvp)

Arguments

w

a \(T \times M\) matrix.

alpha

a \(K \times r\) matrix of the loading matrix \(\alpha\).

k

integer of the number of endogenous variables in the model.

r

integer with the rank of the cointegration matrix \(\Pi\).

reparameterise

logical indicating if the reparameterisation described in Koop et al. (2010) should be performed.

tvp

logical indicating if the SUR matrix with the values of regressors should be prepared for the estimation of constant or time varying parameters.

Value

A sparse block matrix.

Examples


data("e6") # Load data

# Generate model input
mod <- create_bvecmodel(e6, p = 4, r = 1,
                        const = "unrestricted", seasonal = "unrestricted")

# Obtain input data
alpha <- matrix(c(-0.1, 0.16, -0.04, -0.02), 2)
w <- mod$data$train$w

# Constant coefficients
coint_prepare_sur_data(w, alpha, 2, 1, TRUE, FALSE)
